original_ai_output.title_zh: Oyet派系在Leer县俘获47名效忠Regina的SPLA-IO士兵
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据Radio Tamazuj报道，南苏丹团结州Leer县Adok地区，Oyet Nathaniel领导的派系据称俘获至少47名效忠Regina Joseph的SPLA-IO士兵。一名效忠Oyet的军官称，冲突由对方先发挑衅，俘虏目前关押在军事情报设施中。效忠Regina一方的军官承认有人员被俘，但表示尚未收到确认被俘人数的官方通报。自10月冲突爆发以来，双方交火已造成44名士兵死亡。

location.raw_text: Adok payam in Unity State’s Leer County

key_facts.fact: 据称至少47名效忠Regina Joseph的SPLA-IO士兵被Oyet Nathaniel派系俘获
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least 47 SPLA-IO soldiers loyal to Regina Joseph... were reportedly captured by a rival group led by Oyet Nathaniel in Adok payam in Unity State’s Leer County last week.

key_facts.fact: 冲突自10月爆发以来已造成44名士兵死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The fighting between the rival SPLA-IO groups has left 44 soldiers dead since it started in October.

key_facts.fact: 效忠Regina一方的军官承认有人员被俘，但称未收到确认被俘人数的官方通报
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: up to now I have not received any official communication confirming how many of our officers were captured alive by Nathaniel Oyet’s group

key_facts.fact: 一名效忠Oyet的军官称俘虏被关押在军事情报设施和警方刑事调查部门
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: They are being held at our military intelligence facility, and some are detained by our police criminal investigations department.

uncertainties: 被俘人数尚未获得对方官方确认
事件目前仅由单一来源Radio Tamazuj报道，缺乏交叉验证
冲突起因双方说法不一，Oyet方称对方挑衅，Regina方称遭对方攻击
